name: Well Pump Testing and Replacement
short: No water, Low pressure, failed pumps.
body:
When a submersible pump fails, it typically presents with one of three primary symptoms: a total lack of water, low water pressure or intermittent water flow.
During our initial inspection, we will test for a steady power supply, check wire continuity and measure the current draw to accurately diagnose the root cause of the issue.  Once we have completed the assessment and identified the problem, we will walk you through the diagnosis and discuss the appropriate repair or replacement options, along with  transparent pricing, before moving forward with any work.
bullets: Emergency call-outs when you have no water
System testing and diagnostics
Well pump extraction, inspection and replacement

name: Well Tank Replacement
short: Reliable 'blue tank" replacement to restore proper water pressure and keep your well system running efficiently.
body: A well pressure tank stores pressurized water and air to maintain steady water pressure throughout the home and prevent the well pump from turning on and off too frequently. A waterlogged or leaking pressure tank causes the pump to short-cycle, which can quickly damage an otherwise healthy pump.
bullets: Diagnosis of waterlogged and failed tanks
Correctly sized replacement for your household
Pressure switch adjustment and testing
Advice on protecting your pump

name: Well Yield Testing
short: An honest measurement of how much water your well actually produces over a specific period, documented for you.
body: Yield testing determines what your well can reliably deliver over a sustained period, rather than just a brief test. This information is crucial when buying a property, adding bathrooms, planning irrigation, or troubleshooting seasonal water shortages. We perform comprehensive yield testing and provide full written reports.
bullets: Peace of Mind - Buy or sell with complete confidence knowing exactly how many gallons per minute (GPM) the well produces
Prepare for Renovations - Confirm your current well can handle increased demand before adding a bathroom or irrigation.
Optimize System Performance - Ensure your well pump is properly sized for your well's recovery rate to prevent burnout.
Uncover Hidden Issues - Identify failing well pumps or dropping water tables before they turn into costly repairs.

name: Water Testing
short: Understanding water quality before choosing a treatment system.
body:
Cloudy water, copper corrosion, a metallic taste, orange sink staining, and a rotten-egg smell each indicate different water issues that require specific solutions. Testing your water first ensures you treat the actual problem effectively.
We take proper samples, clearly explain the results without a sales pitch, and will tell you honestly if no treatment is necessary.
bullets: Testing for PH, Iron and Hardness (mineral content)
Sampling done correctly
Clear explanation of what each result actually affects
No treatment recommended unless the water needs it
